adjudication.rationale:
Real bug in the diff. In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` `updateEvent()`, `selectedCalendar` is computed as:

```ts
const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId
  ? externalCalendarId
  : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;
```

The `.find(...)` branch only executes when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, but then the predicate compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `=== undefined`/`null`/""), so it will typically never match any real calendar externalId. That means the previous fallback behavior (old code used `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`) is effectively lost, and `selectedCalendar` becomes `undefined` in that scenario, causing the update to fall back to whatever later default is used (or fail), rather than using the destination calendar.
